papers.title: Eye-tracking and cognitive patterns in post-traumatic stress disorder: a scoping review.
papers.reason: The review examines eye-tracking markers and cognitive patterns in a clinical population, providing useful background for gaze-based cognitive assessment.

papers.title: The influence of working memory on the relationship between anxiety and reinforcement learning
papers.reason: The paper directly links human working memory and anxiety to reinforcement-learning behavior, making it highly relevant to process models of executive function.

papers.title: Robot assistants during high mental workload: Understanding Task-Specific Load in Human–Robot Interaction
papers.reason: The proposed experiments measure EEG and behavioral markers of perceptual and working-memory load, although the contribution is preliminary and oriented toward robotic assistance.

papers.title: Relationship between cognitive functioning and diffusion tensor imaging analysis along perivascular spaces as a diffusion magnetic resonance imaging marker of perivascular directional diffusivity in functional seizures after traumatic brain injury.
papers.reason: The study associates an MRI marker with global cognitive and functional measures after traumatic brain injury but does not isolate executive-function processes or develop a digital task biomarker.

papers.title: Temporal Dynamics of Cognitive Change following Acute Aerobic Physical Activity in Emerging Adults
papers.reason: The controlled behavioral study tests working memory and inhibitory control at multiple time points after exercise, yielding relevant findings about executive-task sensitivity.

papers.title: Treating depression predicts cognitive improvement in Mild Cognitive Impairment: a 1-year prospective cohort study.
papers.reason: The study tracks global MMSE and MoCA outcomes in mild cognitive impairment but does not specifically assess or model executive functions.

papers.title: Growth and cognition over eight years in three sites of the MAL-ED cohort study
papers.reason: The cohort relates childhood growth to fluency and reasoning outcomes, but executive function is secondary to the developmental and nutritional focus.

papers.title: CHRONIC PAIN IN SERVICEMEMBERS AND VETERANS WITH GUNSHOT WOUNDS OF THE UPPER EXTREMITIES: EFFECTIVENESS OF SELF-REHABILITATION TECHNOLOGY WITHIN A MEDICO-PSYCHOLOGICAL CORRECTION PROGRAM
papers.reason: Cognition is represented only by a pre-post MoCA outcome in a rehabilitation study primarily focused on pain and psychiatric symptoms.

papers.title: Altered microstructure in end-stage renal disease patients with maintenance hemodialysis
papers.reason: The paper predicts global MoCA scores from diffusion MRI in renal disease but lacks executive-function-specific measures and the target behavioral, gaze, or EEG modalities.

papers.title: AI and speech-based identification of cognitive impairment in maintenance haemodialysis - the ASPIRE study
papers.reason: The study uses multimodal speech features and verbal-fluency tasks to classify MoCA-based cognitive-impairment risk in a clinical population.

papers.title: Comparative efficacy of neuromodulation techniques for Alzheimer’s disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.reason: The meta-analysis concerns treatment effects on broad cognitive and clinical outcomes in Alzheimer’s disease rather than executive-function mechanisms or assessment biomarkers.

papers.title: Altered EEG-derived functional brain states in Parkinson’s disease with mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: Source-reconstructed EEG reveals altered brain-state occupancy and transitions associated with cognitive performance and attentional control in Parkinson’s mild cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Scale-Dependent Development of Neural Signal Complexity and its Association with Working Memory in Childhood
papers.reason: The paper directly examines how developmental neural-signal complexity relates to working-memory ability in children.

papers.title: Economic Scarcity Impedes Impoverished Children's Executive Function: The Role of Multiple Resources Examined Through Eye Tracking.
papers.reason: The study combines experimental resource-depletion manipulations, eye tracking, and executive-function tasks to identify attention and self-control mechanisms in children.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Personalized Learning: A Recommendation System for Digital and Sustainable Education
papers.reason: This is an AI education and recommendation-system framework without a human or animal study or an explicit computational model of human executive function.

papers.title: Digital neurobehavioral signature and its association with cognitive function and psychological resilience: a cross-sectional study of digital lifestyle patterns and cognitive health
papers.reason: The study links a composite digital-lifestyle index to MoCA performance and resilience but neither classifies clinical impairment nor measures executive function specifically.

papers.title: Rapid changes in risk attitudes originate from Bayesian inference on parietal magnitude representations
papers.reason: The paper provides a mechanistic Bayesian model linking working-memory noise, parietal magnitude representations, fMRI signals, and context-dependent risky decisions.
